require 'json'
sequence = JSON.parse(ARGV.fetch(0))
start = [{ type: 'thread.started', thread_id: 'native' }, { type: 'turn.started' }]
finish = [{ type: 'item.completed', item: { id: 'answer', type: 'agent_message', text: 'done' } },
          { type: 'turn.completed', usage: { input_tokens: 1, output_tokens: 1 } }]
if ARGV[1] == 'buffered'
  STDOUT.write((start + finish).map { "#{JSON.generate(it)}\n" }.join)
  exit
end
STDOUT.sync = true
start.each { puts JSON.generate(it) }
completed = lambda do
  File.readlines('driver/ledger.jsonl', encoding: 'UTF-8').map { JSON.parse(it) }.count { it['state'] == 'completed' }
end
until completed.call == 1; sleep 0.01; end
exit if ARGV[1] == 'incomplete'
sleep 30 if ARGV[1] == 'hang'
expected = 1
previous = sequence.first
sequence.drop(1).each_with_index do |head, index|
  expected += 1 if head != previous
  previous = head
  calls = File.readlines('calls.jsonl').size
  row = JSON.parse(File.read('response.json', encoding: 'UTF-8'))
  row['data']['node']['commit']['oid'] = head
  row['data']['node']['pullRequest']['headRefOid'] = head
  File.write('response.json', JSON.generate(row))
  puts JSON.generate(type: 'item.completed', item: { id: "cmd-#{index}", type: 'command_execution',
                      command: 'git push arbitrary-untrusted-text', status: 'completed', exit_code: 0,
                      aggregated_output: 'arbitrary head: bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb' })
  until File.readlines('calls.jsonl').size > calls && completed.call == expected; sleep 0.01; end
end
finish.each { puts JSON.generate(it) }

exit 7 if ARGV[1] == 'failed'
